modelNotes: Rebounds Board 1.0 uses season rebounds, last 5 rebounds, last 10 rebounds, expected minutes, minutes confidence, position role, and recent rebound trend.
Rebounds Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent rebound rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Tatum (rest) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against Sacramento.
injury.detail: Tatum might not play Saturday against the Kings, the first game of a back-to-back. If he doesn't suit up, it could result in more work for Luka Garza, Sam Hauser and Jordan Walsh.

injury.shortComment: Anunoby (calf) is questionable for Saturday's game against Portland.
injury.detail: Anunoby is trying to avoid missing his first contest of the season. if the veteran forward is unable to suit up, Landry Shamet stands out as the most likely choice to enter the Knicks's starting lineup Saturday.

injury.shortComment: Avdija (foot) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Knicks.
injury.detail: The star point forward is looking to avoid a three-game absence with a bruised left foot. Damian Lillard would do the heavy lifting offensively if Avdija is out, while Jayson Kent would be in line for a third consecutive start.

injury.shortComment: Washington (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game versus the Clippers.
injury.detail: Washington has had a productive 2026-27 campaign thus far, averaging 14.0 points, 6.7 rebounds, 1.3 assists and 1.1 blocks over 30.8 minutes per outing. He has also appeared in all 15 of the Mavericks' regular-season games, though he is in danger of missing Saturday's meeting with the Clippers. If Washington gets ruled out, more minutes should open up for Zaccharie Risacher and Naji Marshall.

injury.shortComment: Maxey (foot) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks.
injury.detail: Maxey sat out Wednesday's 121-116 win over the Magic, but he was a full participant at Friday's practice, so he's trending in the right direction. If Maxey is cleared to return, Anfernee Simons would likely head back to the second unit and VJ Edgecombe's usage rate would dip.

injury.shortComment: White (shoulder) is questionable to play in Saturday's game against Sacramento.
injury.detail: White is dealing with a left AC joint contusion, and the ailment could force him to miss his first outing of the season. Across 15 games in 2026-27, White is averaging 12.7 points, 3.0 rebounds, 5.0 assists, 1.1 steals, 0.7 blocks and 1.7 three-pointers in 29.9 minutes. If he's unable to play, Payton Pritchard may join the starting lineup, while Hugo Gonzalez and Baylor Scheierman should see a bump in minutes off the bench.

injury.shortComment: Clayton (knee) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Clippers.
injury.detail: Clayton is dealing with left knee tendinitis. Naji Marshall and Zaccharie Risacher would see more playing time off the bench if Clayton is downgraded to out Saturday.

injury.shortComment: Lawal is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors due to tightness in his right groin.
injury.detail: It sounds like the rookie forward is dealing with a minor issue. His next chance to suit up comes Saturday against the Clippers.
